title: eyemind
description: A dependency-free Logic Script (LS) reasoner with forward and backward reasoning, checkable proofs, and RDF 1.2, Notation3 (N3), SPARQL 1.2 RL (SRL) and Logical English (LE) interoperability. LS is a rule language with JavaScript syntax. eyemind includes a command-line interface, a JavaScript library, and a browser playground.
